visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up and medium shots of a tall persimmon tree filled with ripe orange fruits against a grey, overcast sky. (2) An elderly man wearing a straw hat, a white vest, and brown pants uses a long telescoping pole with a small net attached to the end to reach for and pick persimmons from the high branches. (3) He carefully lowers the net and empties the harvested orange persimmons into a large metal bowl sitting on the paved ground. (4) The scene shifts indoors to a traditional Japanese-style room with wooden pillars and tatami-like elements, where several black and red baskets are overflowing with harvested persimmons. (5) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a dark grey sweatshirt, is shown smiling and picking up a slice of persimmon with a wooden toothpick. (6) She bites into the bright orange fruit slice and looks at the camera with a satisfied and happy expression.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 日本鄉下婆家的柿子樹結果啦. (2) [Subtitle]: 公公找我一起去採柿子. (3) [Subtitle]: 都被烏鴉吃掉了. (4) [Subtitle]: 竟然採到了這麼多！！！. (5) [Subtitle]: 我們要送給家裡沒有柿子樹的朋友鄰居們. (6) [Subtitle]: 有吃不完的清甜柿子超幸福～～～
